properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 9:28AM CDT until August 9 at 10:15AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
SVRMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Green Lake County in south central Wisconsin...
Northeastern Columbia County in south central Wisconsin...

* Until 1015 AM CDT.

* At 928 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles north of
Pardeeville, or 12 miles northeast of Portage, moving east at 20
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Randolph, Markesan, Rio, Cambria, Manchester, Friesland, Kingston,
Doylestown, and Marquette.

People attending Doylestown Firemens Picnic  should seek safe shelter
immediately!
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Large hail, damaging wind, and continuous cloud to ground lightning
are occurring with this storm. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is
one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder,
you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 9:45AM CDT until August 9 at 10:30AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
SVRMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southern Columbia County in south central Wisconsin...
Dane County in south central Wisconsin...

* Until 1030 AM CDT.

* At 945 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Deforest, or
near Windsor, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Madison, Sun Prairie, Fitchburg, Middleton, Stoughton, Waunakee,
Verona, Oregon, McFarland, Monona, Mount Horeb, Windsor, Edgerton,
Columbus, Prairie Du Sac, Marshall, Sauk City, Lake Wisconsin,
Deforest, and Cottage Grove.

People attending Madison Ride the Drive , and Belleville Community
Picnic  should seek safe shelter immediately!

Other landmarks included are the following Locations Wisconsin State
Capitol and Gibraltar Rock Natural Area County Park.
